headline: Gold up ₹148 today to ₹12,656 per gram; silver flat at ₹1,75,000 per kg
summary: Gold rose about 1.18% today, with 24K at ₹12,656 per gram and 22K at ₹11,600, a move that is modest in the context of the past week. Against 7 days ago, 24K is down 7.49% and silver is down 7.89%, while over the last 29 days gold has fallen 11.34% and silver 20.45% from its peak of ₹2,20,000 per kg on 26 October. Spot prices are down slightly since today's rates were set, suggesting the move may fade, and a firmer rupee or softer dollar could be part of the picture.
outlook: Prices are well below late-October and early-November levels, so buyers may compare rates across a few shops before deciding, keeping in mind that making charges and GST are extra.
